title: Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning
categories: Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways
description: Use this service request to report an inlet or storm drain that needs cleaning. Water Utilities is responsible for the maintenance of underground storm sewer main lines, inlet boxes and lateral lines on public property and drainage easements throughout the City of Dallas. Water Utilities is also responsible for the removal of any obstruction in culverts under City maintained streets and alleys. The City of Dallas does not provide cleaning of private property. If this request is regarding an animal, personal items or smoke in the inlet/storm drain, please call 311 for immediate assistance. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 5 business days.

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to clean a public inlet, storm drain, drainage ditch, or City-maintained culvert.
actions.why: For cleaning an inlet or storm drain on public property or a drainage easement, including debris, dirt, grass, or leaves. Dallas Water Utilities also maintains storm sewer lines and removes obstructions in culverts under City-maintained streets and alleys. The 311 request form asks whether the street or alley is flooded, the kind of cleaning or repair needed, the drain contents, and the location.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning" requests does not apply to a flooded street or alley, an animal or personal item or smoke in an inlet or storm drain, or cleaning on private property. If the street or alley is flooded, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online for the hazardous stopped-up condition. If an animal or personal item is in the inlet or storm drain, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online about the hazardous objects-dropped service. If smoke is in the inlet or storm drain, then call 311 by phone instead of submitting a 311 request online. If an inlet is in an apartment-complex parking lot, then notify apartment management or maintenance.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Creeks, Streams, Storm Drains, and Waterways" > Choose "Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning"

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about a flooded street or alley with a stopped-up storm drain.
actions.why: For an inlet/storm drain cleaning concern when the street or alley is flooded. The conditional guidance on the Dallas 311 website directs this situation to the "Inlet/Storm Drain Stopped Up - Hazardous" service by calling 311; that target has no online request button and says to call 311 for more information.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about an animal or personal item in an inlet or storm drain.
actions.why: For an animal or personal item in an inlet/storm drain. The conditional guidance on the Dallas 311 website directs these cases to the dispatched "Objects Dropped in Inlet/Storm Drain - Hazardous" service by calling 311; that target also directs people to call 311.

actions.tagline: Call Dallas 311 about smoke in an inlet or storm drain.
actions.why: For smoke in an inlet or storm drain. The description for "Inlet/Storm Drain Cleaning" requests on the Dallas 311 website directs people to call 311 for immediate assistance.

actions.tagline: Notify apartment management about an inlet in an apartment parking lot.
actions.why: For an inlet on private property in an apartment-complex parking lot. The conditional guidance on the Dallas 311 website directs people to notify apartment management or maintenance because the City does not clean private-property inlets.
